'''June 2001 Normal tournament (30 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois on 30 June 2001. [[Matt Hempstead]] won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2547">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-30-geoff-doesnt-play-at-normald2547/ geoff-doesnt-play-at-normal], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 30 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-30-geoff-doesnt-play-at-normald2547/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Hempstead]]
